method.pass: one bounded live pass with targeted corrective recapture only after unsupported selector/client operations invalidated an observation

findings.evidence: Live public tablist lacked roving tabindex, tab/panel relationships and Arrow/Home/End behavior.
findings.remediation_state: Root agent reported a local fix; live deployment recheck not yet performed.

findings.evidence: Devpost iframe visibly refused youtube.com in Codex IAB and this environment could not connect to youtube.com; public fallback MP4 is HTTP 206, AV-valid, and hash-identical to local source.

limitations: Browser client blocked direct JSON navigation with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; independent HTTP 200, DSSE parse, signature count and decoded receipt IDs supplied the result.
Synthetic key injection did not activate native buttons/summary on either public or local pages; Enter/Space cases are BLOCKED, not product failures.
Devpost dynamic content was visible in the semantic snapshot but unavailable to page-evaluate; snapshot plus HTTP evidence was used.
